entries.title: Diagnosis: reoon verification call failed
entries.detail: Cause (most likely): the GitHub secret REOON_API_KEY was pasted with its .env comment; the failing URL carries the key followed by spaces and '# reoon.com email verifier: free daily credits', so Reoon rejects it with 401. The local .env loader strips ' #' comments, GitHub does not. The key was also written in plain text into this issue's detail and log J0139 on the data branch. Remedy: rotate the Reoon key, set the GitHub secret to the bare key only, and change HttpError/provider errors to redact key= and api_key= query values; then clean the stored issue/log text.
